title: The review threads of the pull request whose diff d opened
description: The file PRS_DIFF_THREADS names in the nvim d starts. It sits beside the diff's socket and is removed once nvim exits. Every field is always present.

slug.description: owner/name of the repository. A Bitbucket owner is the project key.

base.description: The revision the diff runs from, as origin/<base branch>. The diff is three-dot, so its left side is where the branch left this.

head.description: The commit d fetched for the pull request's head, which is the diff's right side.

threads_read.description: False where prs held no detail read for the pull request when the diff opened, such as one on a host whose detail it does not read, so an empty threads list says nothing.

threads.description: Each review thread the detail read holds, in the provider's order.

path.description: The file's path from the repository's root.

line.description: The line the thread is on, counted in the copy of the file side names, and null where that line is gone from the diff.

side.description: LEFT where line counts in the base's copy of the file, and RIGHT where it counts in the head's.

outdated.description: True where the lines it was left on changed since.

comments.description: The thread's comments, oldest first, as many as the detail read asks for.

author.description: The login that wrote it, and empty for a deleted account.

author_type.description: The author's kind, such as User or Bot, in the provider's words, and empty where it does not say.

author_association.description: What the author is to the repo, such as OWNER, COLLABORATOR or NONE, in the provider's words, and empty where it does not say.

comment_count.description: How many comments the thread holds, which can pass the number listed.
